svg.title: Lantern Vale — remaining buildings and scenery
svg.desc: Implemented storehouse and warehouse, mill, market, orchard, stable, saddler, trade house, well, fruit trees, benches, statues, and construction stages. Actual renderer artwork beside existing workers and wilderness trees. Tier and state thumbnails appear below each enlarged scene.
svg.text: Lantern Vale / completing the building family
Actual renderer artwork • distinct workplaces • consistent roofs, materials, and props
Scenes enlarged 2.05×; tier and state thumbnails 0.7×. Workers illustrate scale. Mill sails and stable horses remain separate live artwork.
